name: Selenocysteine
info: The 21st genetically encoded amino acid. It is incorporated through special decoding of UGA; at a pH of about 7, its side chain is predominantly negatively charged.

history.clue: The name indicates an analogue of cysteine with selenium in place of sulfur.
history.story: The name selenocysteine describes its structure: it is an analogue of cysteine with selenium in place of sulfur. Thressa Stadtman's research helped establish the role of selenium in proteins. In 1986, researchers found that UGA, a codon that normally signals a stop in synthesis, occurs at the position of this amino acid in the genes of certain selenium-containing enzymes.

codonNote: UGA is normally a stop codon. Selenocysteine is incorporated through special decoding of UGA with the participation of additional signals and factors.
